name: CyberAuthorizationRecord
description: Private authorization scope and approval record for a CyberAI asset

asset_target.description: Server-captured target snapshot for the authorized asset

asset_type.description: Server-captured asset type for the authorization

scope_target.description: Explicit bounded target or scope description

scope_ports.description: Bounded port numbers or ranges included in scope

scope_web_paths.description: Bounded web paths included in scope

allowed_testing_methods.description: Methods selected from the safe Phase 1 allowlist

evidence_reference.description: Bounded reference to authorization evidence stored by the administrator

valid_from.description: ISO timestamp when the authorization window begins

valid_until.description: ISO timestamp when the authorization window ends

status.description: PENDING, ACTIVE, REVOKED, or server-derived EXPIRED state

owner_email.description: Verified administrator email that created the authorization

owner_user_id.description: Authenticated platform user id that created the authorization

requested_by.description: Verified administrator email that requested the authorization

requested_by_user_id.description: Authenticated platform user id that requested the authorization

approved_by.description: Verified administrator email that approved the authorization

renewed_by.description: Verified administrator email that renewed the authorization

renewed_at.description: Server timestamp for the latest renewal

revoked_by.description: Verified administrator email that revoked the authorization

workspace_key.description: Server-controlled workspace boundary key for future tenancy
